fields.description: The picked icon's own SVG (set by the Menus screen's icon picker), so it draws with no icon library.
fields.label: Icon SVG

fields.description: Unticked items stay in the menu but are not served to visitors.
fields.label: Visible

fields.description: Short flag shown beside the label, e.g. New or Sale.
fields.label: Badge

fields.description: One short line shown under the label when the nav's submenu layout is "Icon + title + description".
fields.label: Description

fields.description: Extra class on this item's rendered link, for site-specific CSS.
fields.label: CSS Class

fields.description: Extra paths that should also light this item up, comma-separated. Use * as a wildcard, e.g. /blog/* so a post keeps the Blog tab active.
fields.label: Also Highlight On

fields.description: Comma-separated breakpoints to hide this item on: desktop, tablet, mobile.
fields.label: Hide On

fields.description: Fill this item's sub-items automatically when the menu is shown: the project's pages, pages under an address, or the latest blog posts. Sub-items you add by hand are not used.
fields.label: Fill Automatically

fields.description: Pages whose address starts with this, e.g. /services
fields.label: Under Address

fields.description: How many sub-items at most (1-20, default 8).
fields.label: Show At Most

fields.description: Stable identity for this row, assigned automatically. Hierarchy is stored against this, not the label.
fields.label: Item Key

fields.description: Item Key of this row's parent. Written alongside Parent Menu, which is kept for the classic theme.
fields.label: Parent Key
